# langsmith_repo_tags (Data Source)

Lists the prompt-repo tag catalog — every tag applied to a prompt repo, with the number of repos carrying it. Use this to discover which tags are in circulation before tagging a repo. This is distinct from `langsmith_prompt_repo_tags`, which lists the named version tags (such as `production`) on a single prompt repo.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The full prompt-repo tag catalog, with a usage count per tag.
data "langsmith_repo_tags" "all" {}

# Narrow the catalog with a search string.
data "langsmith_repo_tags" "chat" {
  query = "Chat"
}

# Tag name -> number of prompt repos carrying it.
output "tag_counts" {
  value = { for t in data.langsmith_repo_tags.all.tags : t.tag => t.count }
}

# Only the tags that are in wide circulation.
output "common_tags" {
  value = [for t in data.langsmith_repo_tags.all.tags : t.tag if t.count >= 100]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `query` (String) If set, only returns tags matching this search string. When omitted, the entire tag catalog is returned.
- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `tags` (Attributes List) The prompt-repo tags, each with its usage count. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) The number of prompt repos carrying this tag.
- `tag` (String) The tag name (for example, `ChatPromptTemplate`).
